title: SSI Index — ssi-data.json (canonical schema, v4.0.2)
description: Per-country SSI scoring output. Top-level fleet summary + array of substation records. Canonical sub-schema captures the COMMON CORE across all 39 SoT countries; country-specific extensions are permitted via additionalProperties (e.g. Baltic trio's richer R3_tier / R6c_flood modifiers, Mexico/Denmark/Greenland's degradation-model Markov variant). Renderer code must use defensive optional-chaining for fields outside the core (KB §64.3 anti-pattern A1). PR-5 (audit memo 2026-06-08): $id pinned with v4.0.2 path segment; new substation fields mult_product / add_sum / modifier_impacts declared as OPTIONAL during the Phase 1 transition (promotion to required scheduled for PR-7 post daily-routine refresh).

meta.description: Metadata block. country + version were not required by older cohorts (EE/LV/LT/IT/TR) so they are optional here; renderer code uses defensive lookup with fallback to the country slug derived from URL path.

total_departments.description: Optional admin-l2 count (default = regions count if single-level)

regions.description: Per-region rollup. Most countries use array; some legacy use dict.

sharded.description: Convention #79 — true when substations live in substations_shards[] rather than inline.

substations_shards.description: Convention #79 shard manifest. Each entry names a sibling file holding a substation array; run_schema_validation.py resolves each shard and validates its records against #/$defs/substation.

substation.description: Core fields required across all countries. Renderers MUST optional-chain extension fields. See KB §64.3 anti-pattern A1.

name.description: OSM name where present. Explicitly null on unnamed substations (UK 25,624, Turkey 25); most countries omit the key instead. Both are Convention #56 honest — an unnamed substation is not given one.

voltage_kv.description: May be null when source OSM voltage tag missing (Czechia, Luxembourg)

mult_product.description: PR-3 (audit memo 2026-06-08): Π of the multiplicative modifier chain after registry clipping. Used by renderer tooltips + v4.2 W-axis governance gate. Optional during Phase 1 transition; promoted to required in PR-7.

add_sum.description: PR-3: Σ of additive modifier deltas (sum of (value − 1.0) for type='add' modifiers like R6c_flood). Applied OUTSIDE soft_clip_upper per the master equation. Optional during Phase 1 transition.

modifier_impacts.description: PR-3: per-modifier delta-from-identity dict {name: round(value − 1.0, 4)} for every recognised modifier on this substation. Renderers consume this for the modifier-breakdown tooltip; v4.2 W1-W10 anti-maladaptation gate consumes it to verify adaptive capacity (R8) balances new risk injections (R6c flood, R6d wildfire, etc.).

modifiers.description: Core 5 modifiers. Baltic trio (EE/LV/LT) has 11-key extension — allowed via additionalProperties.

markov.description: Markov degradation model output. 10 sub-variants observed across countries (KB §64.3 anti-pattern A1). Schema requires only the CORE 3 keys that the renderer references; everything else is country-specific extension.

steady_state.description: Stationary distribution over the degradation chain. Three sanctioned representations: 4-element array over [Healthy, Aging, Degraded, Critical] (37 countries); dict {'Good','Acceptable','Degraded','Critical'} (Mexico); 5-element array (Colombia only, 378 substations, present since the v4.0.2 baseline) — an operator-sanctioned 5-state variant whose ordering was verified against risk_score (corr -0.70 healthy end, +0.67 degraded end). Renderers must accept all three. Costa Rica's string form is NOT sanctioned: an unmigrated v4.0.2 vintage, meant to fail this gate.

P5.description: Fifth-state probability of the Colombia 5-state variant; equals steady_state[4]. Not a percentile — unrelated to the R_P5 Monte Carlo field.
